title: DatePicker configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.DatePickerAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/ai-docs/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

AllowInput.description: Stores the ability to allow inputs to be editable or not

CalendarMode.description: Store calendar mode is in use

DateFormat.description: Display format of the selected date (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY); empty uses the server date format.

Disable.description: Stores the ability to disable a range of dates from datepicker (source type: array)

DisableMobile.description: Stores the ability to disable the mobile flatpickr behavior. False is the default provider option

FirstWeekDay.description: First day of the week in the calendar (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday).

InitialDate.description: Set the property initialDate (source type: string | Date)

MaxDate.description: Latest selectable date; empty for no upper limit.

MinDate.description: Earliest selectable date; empty for no lower limit.

OnChange.description: Set the OnChange Event that will be defined in the specific context for each Flatpickr mode (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

OnClose.description: Set the OnClose callback to be used whenever the Flatpickr close (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

OnMonthChange.description: Set the OnMonthChange callback to be used whenever the Flatpickr month changes (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

OnOpen.description: Set the OnOpen callback to be used whenever the Flatpickr opens (source type: OSFramework.OSUI.GlobalCallbacks.Generic)

ShowTodayButton.description: Renders a Today button in the calendar footer.

ShowWeekNumbers.description: Shows the week-number column in the calendar.

TimeFormat.description: Time selection appended to the calendar: disabled (date only), 12 or 24 (hour format).

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
